title: What time is it right now in USA?

messages.content: What time is it right now in USA?

The current time in the USA varies across its multiple time zones. As of Thursday, May 21, 2026, at 5:17 AM UTC, the times in the main US time zones are:

*   **Eastern Daylight Time (EDT)**: 1:17 AM EDT
*   **Central Daylight Time (CDT)**: 12:17 AM CDT
*   **Mountain Daylight Time (MDT)**: 11:17 PM MDT on Wednesday, May 20, 2026. Some parts of the Mountain Time Zone, such as most of Arizona, observe Mountain Standard Time (MST) year-round, which would be 10:17 PM MST on Wednesday, May 20, 2026.
*   **Pacific Daylight Time (PDT)**: 10:17 PM PDT on Wednesday, May 20, 2026
*   **Alaska Daylight Time (AKDT)**: 9:17 PM AKDT on Wednesday, May 20, 2026
*   **Hawaii Standard Time (HST)**: 7:17 PM HST on Wednesday, May 20, 2026. Hawaii does not observe Daylight Saving Time.

Ekalya is the new official name for the Cosmos Fest, a three-day mega academic, technical, and cultural program at Cosmos College of Management and Technology. It has been rebranded to reflect a broader vision, a stronger academic identity, and deeper interdisciplinary collaboration. Ekalya is jointly organized by the Information and Communication Technology (ICT Club), the Civil Engineering Students’ Society (CESS), and the Student Academic Association of Rising Architects (SAARA). The theme of Ekalya is “Where Ideas, Innovation and Vision Meets,” symbolizing the convergence of conceptual thinking, technical expertise, and creative expression. The event aims to engage students, professionals, and external institutions through competitions, demonstrations, exhibitions, and interactive events.
